extension_v02.note: Additive import02 extension; v0.1 profile_id remains default. New cases and reports use their closed-map profile, replacing v0.1 literal-only restrictions only for the added profile. Exact-display policy, provenance and all old acceptance recipes remain unchanged. See spec/extension-v02.md.
extension_v02.native_import: Explicit metric; results.hellaswag; old bare or exact none-filter keys; whitelisted derived extract; original-byte SHA and JSON pointers; operator review pending, confirmed=false; no evaluation or completed-execution inference.

fields.meaning: 불변 모델 식별; 로컬 digest로 논문 revision 역추정 금지
유일 ID+레코드 내용 hash의 평가 순서 목록

primitives.nonempty_string: UTF-8 JSON string length>=1; no coercion
primitives.json_object: strict JSON object; data only; no executable interpretation
primitives.string_map: object nonempty_string -> nonempty_string; sorted keys; no inferred versions
primitives.seed_map: object nonempty_string -> integer; empty map known only if source explicitly states no seeds/randomness
primitives.relative_artifact_path: artifacts/下 POSIX relative path; forbid dot/dotdot, empty segments, backslash, percent, NUL, absolute paths, all symlinks
primitives.enum:NAME: exact case-sensitive member of enums[NAME]

manifest.values: all semantic+context paths -> envelope; exact keyset

evidence.field_paths: array of unique registry path or score or imported_run

record_rules.exact_keys: 모든 record는 위 declared keys만 허용; all required unless explicitly null. actual manifest extends manifest. Additional data allowed only inside explicitly json_object/string_map/seed_map.
record_rules.revision: git_commit full40; content_addressed sha256:<64hex>. unresolved preserves literal main/latest/tag/abbreviation and is effective unknown; invalid kind/format is rejected, no repair.
record_rules.envelope: known requires non-null typed value. unknown requires null+nonempty reason (not_reported if absent in source). N/A requires null+allowlisted reason; missing evidence becomes effective unknown not validation success evidence.
record_rules.score: known requires raw_value and raw_unit, allowed finite range; unknown requires both null and reason. N/A forbidden. source_rounding not_reported does not invent precision.
record_rules.actual_null: actual.json may be null; all comparison fields unknown; effective run not_run
record_rules.source_locator: 문서는 PDF 1-based page와 표/행/열 또는 section/line; 로그/설정은 JSON pointer 또는 1-based 행 범위. locator는 사람 확인이 필수이며 native 구조 자동 파싱하지 않음.
record_rules.mapping: evidence.field_paths binds claim; absent/mismatched binding/confirmed=false -> effective unknown. Invalid reference ID, referenced file missing/hash mismatch -> validation rejected.
record_rules.raw_unit: metric.definition.unit is canonical fraction only when explicit score unit or cited metric definition supports it; unknown unit never inferred from numeric size.
record_rules.identity: source_id and immutable revision both required; git/content_addressed never interchangeable; equality is declared identity not verified loaded bytes.
record_rules.manifest_id: reported/actual manifest IDs must differ; changed content requires new version by workflow. Each audit records exact input digests; no signed history or automatic detection of edits to an unavailable previous version is claimed.

sample_index.shape: ordered JSON array of {id:nonempty_string,record_sha256:sha256}; unique ids; nonempty for data; fewshot may empty only with count=0 gate
sample_index.hash: canonical entire array; list order preserved
sample_index.cross_checks: data length == data.sample_count; fewshot length == fewshot.count; record hashes are imported statements, not independently verified source records

task_config.hash: canonical entire object; source mapping human-confirmed; no YAML/Jinja execution

prompt_spec.hash: canonical entire object; exact strings; no strip/Unicode normalization or tokenizer execution

scoring_spec.hash: canonical entire object; describes imported semantics, no evaluation code

utf8_text.hash: SHA-256 raw bytes; no newline normalization

digest_policy.canonical_json: UTF-8; sorted object keys; compact separators; ensure_ascii=false; finite JSON only; no Unicode normalization; preserve arrays; decimal score values remain strings
digest_policy.source_digest: hash exact bytes read once; source digest and canonical payload digest distinct
digest_policy.field_digest: digest fields need matching payload_ref type and recomputed payload digest; missing payload or unresolved revision inside an otherwise well-typed payload -> effective unknown (e.g. unresolved task_revision); supplied malformed/incorrect digest or invalid payload schema -> rejected
digest_policy.no_proof: 형식/해시/목록 일치는 진짜 평가 수행·원문 진실·실제 source record bytes 동일성의 독립 증명이 아님

profile_rules.unsupported_reported: known supported-evidence reported anchor contradicts profile -> validation rejected unsupported_profile; unknown anchor stays accepted but blocks; actual contradiction stays different
profile_rules.version: no forced upstream commit or CPU preset; compare imported immutable evaluator revision exactly
profile_rules.generation: no generation for this design profile; verified N/A only; known generation settings not supported. AC-015 deferred rather than pretending temperature affects acc.

provenance_policy.human_confirmed_reported: reviewed paper or explicitly paper-linked immutable supplement; defaults/inference forbidden
provenance_policy.imported_observed: operator-confirmed mapping from existing local log/config to normalized field; artifact bytes+locator; NOT this tool observing runtime or verifying native schema semantics
provenance_policy.manual_declaration: retained claim but effective unknown; not upgraded by matching values
provenance_policy.synthetic: case recipes only; never usable evidence for a real case
provenance_policy.trust_limit: local evidence binding and human mapping; no signed/remote/independent execution proof

comparison_policy.validation_first: rejected => comparison/imported_run/metric null; no normal status summary or partial comparison
field_rules: unknown on either side -> unknown even same raw bytes/null
both usable known exact typed values -> equal or different
both verified same N/A gate -> not_applicable
verified applicable vs verified N/A -> different; unverified applicability -> unknown
comparison_policy.overall_rules: any semantic different => blocked_mismatch; else any semantic unknown => blocked_unknown; else comparable; preserve all blocking reasons
comparison_policy.context: field states reported separately as warnings; never enter overall; show context_incomplete/context_different
comparison_policy.override: none; notes do not change source values, policy or blocked states

imported_run_policy.no_actual_or_no_usable_record: effective state not_run; means no supported imported run record, not proof that no historic run happened
imported_run_policy.known_record: claimed_state and imported_observed evidence of terminal record; operator-confirmed; no this-tool execution attestation
imported_run_policy.completed: usable imported terminal completion plus processed_sample_count == usable actual data.sample_count. If count unknown -> not_run with incomplete_completion_evidence; if known contradictory count -> rejected inconsistent_completion
imported_run_policy.failed_cancelled: preserve supported imported failed/cancelled; never compare partial score; no kill/signal handling in P0
imported_run_policy.unsupported_claim: preserve claimed_state; effective not_run, unverified_imported_run diagnostic
imported_run_policy.integrity: corrupt referenced artifact rejects entire audit; never invent effective failed from a corrupt file

metric_policy.comparison_target: imported displayed decimal values, not latent unrounded accuracy
metric_policy.normalization: explicit fraction unchanged; explicit percent divide by exactly 100; preserve raw value/unit/method; unknown unit blocks score; no heuristic conversion
metric_policy.arithmetic: decimal strings -> exact integer ratios with powers-of-ten denominators; no JSON float, no Decimal context rounding
metric_policy.rounding: source_rounding recorded independently; rounded/not_reported warnings, never widening tolerance; exact-display equality only
metric_policy.otherwise: not_computed with reason; no delta/score success badge/leaderboard; raw scores may be reference only
metric_policy.scientific_verdict: not_assessed; neither within nor outside establishes paper truth/reproduction/significance

input_artifacts.artifacts/: operator supplied source and normalized payload files; never fetched automatically

validation.json.errors: array of {code, safe relative pointer}; no raw offending values

report.json.comparison: {fields:all semantic paths -> field result,context:all context paths -> field result,overall,blocking_paths,warnings}
report.json.limitations: provenance and context limitations always visible

output_records.field_result: {status, left_state, right_state, adopted_left, adopted_right, evidence_refs, reason}; reference claims vs usable values separated
output_records.artifact-index.json: relative output name/size_bytes/SHA-256 for validation/report/html/inputs; excludes itself (no circular digest). Input source digests in canonical evidence index.
output_records.inputs.canonical.json: canonical normalized {case,reported,actual,evidence}; no raw source/log copy; safe relative paths only
output_records.report.html: same states/reasons/policy/digests as JSON; no hidden positive badge; no execution/authentication claim

cli_proposal.effect: new templates only; all fields unknown; fixed policy; no defaults pretending reported facts
strict normalized import and fresh local-only report; no native format detection or execution

exit_codes.3: I/O failure; no successful audit bundle

safety_policy.input_boundary: explicit case root; referenced files under artifacts only; all symlinks/path escapes forbidden; reject percent-encoded path instead of decoding/repair
safety_policy.output_boundary: explicit new out root; no existing path or symlink parent; stage/rename atomic; clean incomplete new staging only; no overwrite option
safety_policy.html: escape text; no scripts/events/remote resources/clickable external links. CSP default-src none; style-src unsafe-inline for fixed styles only.
safety_policy.secrets: allowlisted fields only; reject secret/credential key names, PEM private key patterns, REPRODIFF_SYNTHETIC_SECRET_DO_NOT_EXPORT, absolute home paths. No raw log copy/export or raw value echo in errors. Provider must pre-sanitize evidence; arbitrary free-text secret detection is not guaranteed.
safety_policy.integrity: read bytes once; verify source and supplied payload digests; reopening revalidates required artifacts, never reuse cached success

invariants: invalid input never gets a normal comparison overall/run/metric
unknown never becomes equal; not_reported remains honest even when all score comparison is blocked
field status refers to usable evidence level, not raw claim similarity
semantic/context policies cannot be changed per case
same sample count does not mean same content or order
imported completed does not mean this tool executed, comparable, or reproduced
blocked/failed/cancelled/no usable score means metric not_computed
fixed exact display policy is never loosened after seeing results
no independent source/runtime/customer proof from structural checks or synthetic expectations
p1_deferred: native result format adapters after actual compatibility check
MLflow export and automated literature extraction
